## Regression checklist

- [ ] Exact target revision launches
- [ ] Different executable hash does not match
- [ ] Patch can be disabled in the game profile
- [ ] Suspend/resume works
- [ ] Return to library works
- [ ] Launching another game receives no patch settings
- [ ] No IPA, executable, save data or unlicensed resource is committed
